notes:
- Update prompts at startup are now limited to once every 16 hours, so you typically see one prompt per workday.
- Update prompt now includes Ignore this version, so you can stop reminders for a specific version and still update later from Preferences.
- The startup What’s Changed window now shows reliably after updates, even when release notes are temporarily unavailable.
- Preferences now shows the real SDX product version (including preview labels) instead of a misleading 1.0.0 assembly number.
- When an update is waiting for Revit to fully close, the updater now shows a status window: Waiting for Revit to close, please wait.
- Closing the updater wait window now cancels the pending update; it also includes a Force Close Revit option.
- If multiple Revit sessions are open, updater launch is now deferred until the last Revit instance closes.
- Updater wait window is now branded as SDX Updater and supports a custom SDX icon.
